name: firstCreatorAddedNoExisting
expected: _creators[1] is set to newOne, _hasNonDefaultCreator becomes true, _explicitCreators bitmask for type 1 remains 0.

name: firstExplicitCreatorAddedNoExisting
expected: _creators[1] is set to newOne, _hasNonDefaultCreator becomes true, _explicitCreators bitmask for type 1 has the bit set (bit 1).

name: existingExplicitNewImplicitIgnoresNew
input: Existing = explicitCreator1 at typeIndex = 1; newOne = newImplicitCreator, typeIndex = 1, explicit = false
expected: Since oldOne exists, (_explicitCreators & mask) != 0 is true, and !explicit is true, so it returns immediately without replacing _creators[1].

name: existingExplicitNewExplicitSameTypeClassAndRawParamThrowsException
input: Existing = explicitCreator1 (Class A, rawParamType String); newOne = explicitCreator2 (Class A, rawParamType String), typeIndex = 1, explicit = true
expected: Both explicit, same class, same raw parameter type -> throws IllegalArgumentException due to conflicting creators.

name: existingExplicitNewExplicitSameClassNewParamMoreGenericKeepsOld
input: Existing = explicitCreator1 (Class A, rawParamType String); newOne = explicitCreator2 (Class A, rawParamType Object), typeIndex = 1, explicit = true
expected: newType (Object) isAssignableFrom oldType (String) is true -> keeps old creator (returns without modifying _creators[1]).

name: existingExplicitNewExplicitSameClassNewParamMoreSpecificReplacesOld
input: Existing = explicitCreator1 (Class A, rawParamType Object); newOne = explicitCreator2 (Class A, rawParamType String), typeIndex = 1, explicit = true
expected: newType (String) is assignable from oldType (Object) is false -> replaces old creator with newOne, and updates explicit bitmask.

name: existingImplicitNewExplicitOverridesOld
input: Existing = implicitCreator1; newOne = explicitCreator2, typeIndex = 1, explicit = true
expected: Since existing was not explicit ((_explicitCreators & mask) == 0), verify is set to !explicit (false). Skips verification block, updates _creators[1] with newOne and sets explicit bitmask.

name: existingImplicitNewImplicitVerifyTrueSameClassSameTypeThrowsException
input: Existing = implicitCreator1 (Class A, rawParamType Integer); newOne = implicitCreator2 (Class A, rawParamType Integer), typeIndex = 2 (int), explicit = false
expected: Neither explicitly annotated (verify = !explicit = true), same class, same parameter type -> throws IllegalArgumentException.

name: existingImplicitNewImplicitDifferentClassSkipsVerification
input: Existing = implicitCreator1 (Class A); newOne = implicitCreator2 (Class B), typeIndex = 1, explicit = false
expected: oldOne.getClass() == newOne.getClass() is false -> verification block skipped, replaces _creators[1] with newOne.

name: typeIndexBoundaryZeroDefaultCreator
expected: Correctly indexes into _creators[0] using mask (1 << 0), sets explicit bit for type 0, and updates _hasNonDefaultCreator to true.

name: typeIndexBoundaryMaxPropertyCreator
expected: Correctly indexes into _creators[7] using mask (1 << 7), sets explicit bit for type 7, and updates _hasNonDefaultCreator to true.

input: newOne = mockAnnotatedWithParams, typeIndex = 1, explicit = false, _canFixAccess = true
